d:
"O Mere Pyar Aaja" from the 1965 film Bhoot Bangla is a hauntingly beautiful melody sung by Lata Mangeshkar.
With music by R.D. Burman and lyrics by Hasrat Jaipuri, the song features Mehmood and Tanuja in this iconic musical thriller directed by Mehmood himself.
Movie: Bhoot Bangla (1965 )
Song Name: O Mere Pyar Aaja
Singer: Lata Mangeshkar
Lyrics: Hasrat Jaipuri
Music: R.D. Burman
Cast: Mehmood, Tanuja Mukherjee, Ameen Sayani
